chunks: From him, from Aḥmad, from al-Ḥusayn, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If you have prayed facing other than the qiblah, and it becomes clear to you before morning that you prayed facing other than the qiblah, then repeat your salat.

key_terms.غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ: other than the direction of the qiblah

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they discover before morning that they prayed in the wrong direction of the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who performs salat in a direction other than the qiblah and later realizes the mistake before the relevant time has passed. It indicates that when the error becomes known before morning, the salat must be repeated.
